tierReason: Dev tooling script and docs for testing a branch on the phone; no product code or Sensitive Area

findings.text: scripts/dev-phone.mjs startApi: if the API crashes after start, tsx watch stays alive waiting for a file change, so the script keeps Expo running instead of stopping (seen by killing the API node process in testing). Normal tsx-watch behaviour; the [api] log shows the crash.
scripts/dev-phone.mjs readEnvFile: a PORT line with an inline comment (PORT=3000 # x) would be read as '3000 # x' and give a bad URL. .env.example has no inline comments.
